claims.claim_text: In 2024, the Biden administration is investing in new sources of income for U.S. farmers.
In 2024, the Biden administration is working to make U.S. agriculture the world's first farm sector to reach net-zero emissions by 2050.
Under President Biden's climate law, the U.S. Agriculture Department is paying farmers to adopt climate-smart practices.
By 2024, over 80,000 U.S. farms covering 75 million acres have adopted climate-smart practices.
Commitment to prevent Republican repeal of President Biden's clean-energy investments from undermining U.S. clean-energy businesses.
Commitment to prevent Republican repeal of President Biden's clean-energy investments from sending hundreds of thousands of jobs overseas.
Commitment to prevent Republican repeal of President Biden's clean-energy investments from depriving Americans of cheaper, cleaner energy choices.
Republican efforts to repeal President Biden's clean-energy investments are portrayed as motivated by pleasing special-interest backers.
President Biden's clean-energy investments are lowering U.S. energy costs.
President Biden's clean-energy investments are creating well-paid jobs.
President Biden's clean-energy investments are revitalizing local economies.
President Biden's clean-energy investments are reducing pollution.
The Biden administration has placed U.S. transportation on track to eliminate all carbon emissions by 2050.
The Biden administration is making major transportation-infrastructure investments, including cleaner shipping, trucking, transit, rail and aviation.
The Biden administration has issued the strictest-ever U.S. fuel-economy and tailpipe standards.
The Biden administration's fuel-economy and tailpipe standards improve new cars' mileage.
The Biden administration's fuel-economy and tailpipe standards reduce new cars' emissions per mile by as much as 50 percent.
